## Context

## Testing Mode: UPDATE (new test file)

| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |

## Implementation Steps
1. Create tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-phase-f-subbranch.sh following the structural test pattern (grep SKILL.md for named contract identifiers)
2. Test functions:
   - test_phase_f_subbranch_naming_contract: SKILL.md Phase F section contains 'bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-0' naming pattern
   - test_phase_f_subbranch_tier1_naming: SKILL.md Phase F section contains 'tier-1' sub-branch reference
   - test_phase_f_zero_bug_tier_skip: SKILL.md Phase F section documents zero-bug-tier → no sub-branch created, no PR annotation
   - test_phase_f_instructions_colocated: SKILL.md Phase F section header (not preamble) contains the sub-branch instructions (check 'Phase F' section has sub-branch mention, not only in a separate 'preamble' section)
   - test_phase_f_one_branch_per_tier: SKILL.md Phase F section states 'exactly one sub-branch per' or 'one sub-branch per tier' (no per-bug chunking)
3. chmod +x tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-phase-f-subbranch.sh
4. Append RED marker to .test-index:
   plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md: [test_phase_f_subbranch_naming_contract, test_phase_f_subbranch_tier1_naming, test_phase_f_zero_bug_tier_skip, test_phase_f_instructions_colocated, test_phase_f_one_branch_per_tier]

NOTE: .test-index marker for SKILL.md may already exist from S3 tasks. The RED marker format allows multiple entries for the same source file — append a new line if needed, OR check if there is already a RED marker entry for SKILL.md and update it by appending the new test names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- New test file created and executable
- All 5 structural tests present and fail (RED phase)
- .test-index contains RED marker with 5 new test function names
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits non-zero; RED markers expected
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
